versions.changelog: fix(v1.6.0): watchdog 12-day silent failure due to path encoding bug. Uses 8.3 short path for non-ASCII repo paths.
fix(v1.6.0): watchdog 12-day silent failure due to path encoding bug
Replace VBScript launcher with conhost --headless; remove pcl-run-hidden.vbs; eliminates VBScriptDeprecationAlert on Windows 11+
v1.5.1 - Docs now match behavior: disclose the same-origin fetch('./') update poll (addresses the ClawHub SkillSpector Underdeclared Capability finding). Browser script byte-identical to v1.5.0.

v1.5.0 - Resizable picker with a remembered size: drag the bottom-right grip to resize both axes; the size persists in localStorage and is restored on the next open, double-click resets. Long model names now show a hover tooltip. SKILL.md and LICENSE now ship all 8 languages.

Fix the enhancement silently reverting to the stock list while the page stays open: only the rendered picker instance is enhanced now (a hidden sibling could previously steal it), the stylesheet self-heals and a 1s heartbeat recovers any silent loss, and the official search filter no longer drops the two-column layout.

Compatibility verified on OpenClaw 2026.9.3 (controlled details picker). Docs: the GitHub package now ships a Windows auto-repair watchdog that re-injects the enhancement after an upgrade wipes dist/control-ui; it is not part of this artifact. No functional change to the portable core.

Self-update watchdog: an already-open Control UI tab now fetches the app shell every 5 minutes (plus 30s after load), compares the injected tag version/fingerprint, and reloads automatically when the server is newer - never downgrades, never interrupts typing. Verified end-to-end (v6 page auto-reloaded to v7 within ~25s).
Docs: attribution signature updated to Pondsi (+MiMo-v2.5 +deepseek-v4.1-flash-expires-on-0910 +GLM5.3-flash) - automatically committed by OpenClaw. No functional change.

Renamed to ModelSelectorOpenClaw. Fixed silent fallback on narrow viewports (threshold 520->340, responsive provider column), added content-fingerprint cache busting (?h=sha256-8), DOM state markers and window.pclModelPickerDiag(). Verified end-to-end in a real authenticated Control UI at 1440/480/360px.
